decisions.text: Viktor Gyökeres was shown a straight red against Porto and is banned for 1 match. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 2 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 1 match ban stood.
